limits: Same six nominal zero-raw units with distinct complete condition/fixture realizations; no new physical population or range qualification.
C clamp keeps differential input/output fixed while common mode changes. D1 ties the negative input to output and has a finite input source: these are different fixtures.
AC is a local signal response at the new OP; it is not a loop return ratio, phase margin, finite excursion or recovery measurement.
A fixed5pF capacitor is not a full pass-gate charge model or an LDO.
All former study confirmations are known development evidence for new decisions; old self-bias and September12 research remain paused.
